description: GEOTESLA compares a clayey-soil slope in its natural condition with a slope treated using chemical agents and electrokinetic processes. The release includes model geometry, construction and sensor documentation, plus synchronised acceleration and displacement histories from progressively stronger shaking. The description specifies TDM instrument files. The dataset is provided by IZIIS, Skopje through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2026.
